title: 《三国：逆天改命》第一幕精修版：祁山急报与烛下玄机
dramatic_premise: 47岁诸葛亮隐瞒老花眼强撑统帅威严 -> 暴雨夜张郃绝密竹简撞帐、马谡当众催读 -> 丞相推远竹简失焦陷入绝境 -> 顾渊借拨灯芯无声将凸透镜卡入光路保全丞相天威 -> 丞相瞬间看破断水毒计、当场喝止马谡登山

shots.beat_title: 强钩子：暴雨急报撞帐（0-3.75秒生死倒计时切入）
shots.lens_and_movement: 28mm anamorphic lens, low-angle tracking push-in following the mud-splattered scout bursting through the tent flap
shots.axis_180_geography: Camera-Left: rain-lashed tent entrance & iron brazier | Center: mud-soaked scout dropping to one knee | Camera-Right: assembled Shu generals turning in alarm
shots.speaker: Scout
shots.spoken_line: 报——！陇右八百里加急！张郃前锋已过渭水，截获魏军绝密调兵竹简！
shots.subtext_motivation: 打破平庸开场，第一秒就用带血的未读绝密军报把诸葛亮推入『必须当众立即研判蝇头细字』的绝境。

shots.beat_title: 人际施压：马谡傲慢请战与众将逼视（把丞相架在火上烤）
shots.lens_and_movement: 50mm anamorphic lens, over-the-shoulder from behind Zhuge Liang's left shoulder toward Ma Su and Wei Yan on camera-right, slow tense push-in
shots.axis_180_geography: Foreground Left: Zhuge Liang's dark-teal GuanJin shoulder silhouette | Center: clay sand table of Jieting | Right Midground: Ma Su stepping forward arrogantly beside Wei Yan
shots.speaker: MaSu
shots.spoken_line: 丞相！区区张郃何足道哉？请丞相即刻宣读竹简军情，某愿立军令状，连夜赶往街亭屯兵当道！
shots.subtext_motivation: 马谡急于抢功，当众催促诸葛亮『即刻宣读竹简』，无形中封死了诸葛亮退后私阅的退路，将戏剧张力拉满。

keyframe_anchors.facial_micro_expression: Mouth closed, expectant proud gaze locked toward camera-left.

shots.beat_title: 隐秘危机：丞相展简失焦（Show, Don't Tell 物理光学细节）
shots.lens_and_movement: 85mm anamorphic portrait lens, medium close-up on Zhuge Liang seated at camera-left desk, shallow depth of field
shots.axis_180_geography: Camera-Left/Center: Zhuge Liang seated behind wooden desk holding unrolled bamboo scroll | Camera-Right Background: Gu Yuan standing quietly in half-shadow behind the brass oil lamp
shots.speaker: ZhugeLiang
shots.spoken_line: 且慢……张郃用兵老辣，此简所载行军里数，干系三军生死……
shots.subtext_motivation: 诸葛亮嘴上说『且慢、干系三军生死』是在拖延时间！画面上他将竹简一点点推远到一臂之外、眉头紧锁微眯双眼，用纯物理动作告诉观众：他看不清上面的蝇头小楷！

keyframe_anchors.body_blocking: Zhuge Liang's right thumb presses tightly against the edge of the bamboo slip to steady a faint tremor, head held level.

shots.beat_title: 微距铁证：失焦蝇头小楷 vs 借拨灯芯无声入画的凸透镜（全场高潮转折）

shots.axis_180_geography: Foreground Left: Zhuge Liang's fingers holding bamboo slip | Center Optical Axis: sleek metal-rimmed convex eyeglass lens sliding smoothly between candle flame and bamboo slip | Background: sharp black ink characters
shots.speaker: GuYuan
shots.spoken_line: 丞相，夜雨湿寒，容属下为您拨亮灯芯。
shots.subtext_motivation: 顾渊绝不当众喊『丞相您老花眼戴个眼镜吧』（那会瞬间毁掉诸葛亮的统帅威严！），而是以『拨亮灯芯』为掩护，将凸透镜片精准卡在诸葛亮视线与竹简之间，既保全丞相天威，又瞬间破局！
shots.character_card: 顾渊|随军参军 · 守夜人

shots.beat_title: 破局决断：丞相双目寒光乍现·当场改令破马谡（高燃爽点兑现）
shots.lens_and_movement: 50mm anamorphic lens, low-angle slowtilt up and pull back as Zhuge Liang leans forward with thunderous authority
shots.axis_180_geography: Camera-Left/Center: Zhuge Liang leaning forward over desk, white feather fan striking the Jieting river valley on the sand table | Camera-Right: Gu Yuan stepping back respectfully into shadow
shots.speaker: ZhugeLiang
shots.spoken_line: 好一个张郃！竟欲断我街亭汲水之道！马谡听令——严禁弃城登山！王平即刻分兵五千死守水源，违令者斩！
shots.subtext_motivation: 看清竹简上『断绝水道』四字后，诸葛亮瞬间识破张郃毒计并预判了马谡『弃城登山』的死穴，一改前镜的迟疑，雷霆下令逆天改命！
